I am writing this formal complaint on behalf of the residents of Rainbow Layout. For the last six months, ever since the optical fiber cable digging was completed, the main arterial road connecting 5th main to the ring road has been left in an utterly deplorable condition. There are multiple craters, uneven asphalt settling, and gravel completely strewn across both lanes. Two days ago, during peak morning hours, an elderly citizen lost balance on a two-wheeler trying to avoid a severe water-filled pothole and suffered fractures. The school bus refuses to enter our street now because the axle scraping is severe. We have submitted multiple paper petitions to the local ward office with zero response. This road serves over 1200 apartments and daily office commuters who have no alternative exit route. If this road is not tarred and restored immediately, the upcoming monsoon rains will turn the entire stretch into an impassable mud slush, completely cutting off emergency vehicles and ambulance access to our community. Please treat this as urgent.

Extreme drinking water crisis in sector 7 HSR Layout caused by an underground pipeline failure. Over the past 48 hours, clean treated drinking water has been gushing out from an inspection chamber right in front of the community park. The volume of clean drinking water wasted is immense, estimated at over 50,000 liters every few hours, while neighboring households have not received a single drop in their overhead tanks for three consecutive days. Tanker vendors are exploiting the artificial shortage by charging exorbitant rates of Rs 2500 per tanker. The continuous waterlogging has also weakened the compound wall of the neighboring government school, creating a secondary structural safety hazard. We need BWSSB emergency maintenance teams to isolate the main valve, excavate the cracked joint, and replace the corroded section immediately.

Urgent safety hazard regarding an overloaded step-down distribution transformer installed adjacent to a busy residential market and kindergarten in Jayanagar 4th Block. Over the past two days, the transformer unit has been making violent buzzing and vibrating noises, accompanied by frequent intense blue sparks and smoke puffs emanating from the ceramic bushings. Heavy black dielectric oil is leaking steadily onto the pavement below, creating a slippery flammable pool right where school children and market shoppers walk. The metal enclosure door has been broken off its hinges, exposing 11kV live terminal busbars completely unprotected at waist height. In the event of heavy rain or a momentary short circuit, this unit threatens to explode catastrophically, inflicting third-degree burns and lethal shrapnel injuries on nearby pedestrians. BESCOM vigilance and maintenance division must de-energize and cordon off this lethal hazard immediately.

Severe public health menace due to an unauthorized solid waste dumping ground that has mushroomed over an open vacant civic amenity site in BTM Layout 2nd Stage. Every evening after 9 PM, commercial waste collectors and restaurant workers unload tens of garbage bags containing rotten food, poultry offal, wet kitchen waste, and biomedical plastic waste. The municipal sweepers do not clear this spot because it is considered private property, leading to decomposition and rank putrid odor that permeates residential apartments up to the 4th floor. The site has become an active breeding nursery for swarms of green flies, mosquitoes, and packs of aggressive feral dogs that regularly chase two-wheelers and bite delivery workers. We demand installation of CCTV surveillance, heavy fines on violators, and immediate deployment of a JCB bobcat to completely haul away the 10 tons of putrefied waste.
